Milestone 1 demo: Larkspur Ceramics
25 November 2026

What we showed
Purchase orders from email into your order sheet, the exceptions list for codes that match nothing, and the one-off clean-up of your product codes.

What works
4 of 4 checks working.
- Ten September orders arrived in the sheet with every line right.
- Emails with no readable purchase order went to the exceptions list.
- Codes that match nothing stopped on the exceptions list with the code and the customer.
- Every sampled product code is in the LC-nnnn form.

Not yet
Nothing from this milestone. The order confirmation view and the orders into QuickBooks Online come in milestone 2.

What happens next
The exceptions list will be sorted by customer, as your order coordinator asked; that is part of the agreed scope, at no charge. Then milestone 2 begins.

Changes to price
Showing stock on hand on the confirmation view is new: no system in the agreed scope holds stock levels. I will write it up with a price before any work on it.
